nodes.title: Order of the inertia group
Completions of number fields at finite places

nodes.summary: There is a real constant $C > 0$ such that for every $N \in \mathbb{N}$ there exist a natural number $d \ge N$ and a totally real number field $K$ of degree $[K : \mathbb{Q}] = d$ whose discriminant $\Delta_K$ satisfies $|\Delta_K| \le C^d$.
nodes.title: Martinet's totally real towers

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a number field and let $(u_v)$ be a family of units of the ring of integers of $F$, indexed by the infinite places $v$ of $F$. Write $w(x)$ for the absolute value of $x$ at an infinite place $w$. If $w(u_v) < 1$ for all infinite places $v$ and $w$ with $w \ne v$, then the subgroup of the unit group of the ring of integers generated by the $u_v$ has finite index.
nodes.title: Units small away from the diagonal generate a subgroup of finite index

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a totally complex number field of degree $n = [K : \mathbb{Q}] \ge 18$ and discriminant $d_K$. Then $|d_K| \ge 8.25^n$; equivalently, the root discriminant $|d_K|^{1/n}$ of $K$ is at least $8.25$.
nodes.title: Odlyzko's root discriminant bound in degree at least 18
